reviewer: Codex, personal complete-final-answer read; no paid judge
primary_route: Isotope-resolved pulse tracking, regeneration-step interruption/restoration and defined reconstitution with carbon balance.

checks.quote: ## Proposed conclusion and decision rule
checks.reason: No pre-execution consultation of prior primary Methods/supplements or validated tracer, inhibitor and reconstitution protocols with detailed-condition transfer checks.

checks.quote: E\(_R\)-restored reconstitution
checks.reason: No inactive-enzyme or matched-protein add-back control for restoration. Equal other components and general killed-preparation blanks do not isolate activity-specific rescue from protein/buffer/stabilization introduced by the add-back.

checks.quote: Prepare independent tissue-derived oxidation preparations
checks.reason: No identifiable tissue/organelle preparation choice or procedure resolving that material prerequisite. Independent sources/days alone do not define the assay system.

checks.quote: determined by calibration rather than assumed
checks.reason: Buffer/cofactor/temperature/enzyme/substrate quantities remain unnamed settings to calibrate without a concrete selection/preparation procedure.

checks.quote: J_{\mathrm{return}}
checks.reason: Primary ratio J_return/J_S-ox can be undefined or unstable when the blocked arm has zero/near-zero oxidation. No denominator floor, alternative estimand or below-limit/missing-ratio rule is specified.

checks.quote: consistently positive across independent preparations
checks.reason: Primary ratio contrast lacks an explicit uncertainty/CI procedure; a CI is discussed for the secondary turnover index only. Consistent signs are not an inferential model.

checks.quote: low, intermediate, high X
checks.reason: No bounded dose selection and criterion tying the dose range to assay/biological limits before confirmation, despite useful event-based timing calibration.

checks.quote: Stop and redesign
checks.reason: No refrozen revised procedure with fresh independent confirmation after repairs.

checks.quote: metabolite-depleted tissue fraction
checks.reason: A depleted tissue/enzyme fraction with recorded intentional additions is not compositionally defined. No actual purified component inventory/recovery validation excludes unmeasured enzymes or parallel reactions in the claimed independent system.

checks.quote: fully recorded component list
checks.reason: No raw-file/sample links and exact atom-map/model/software/code/settings audit trail.

checks.quote: no larger than the pre-specified combined uncertainty
checks.reason: Correct evidence and mapped-return versus exchange/activation logic. Standards, extraction/isotope/gas calibration and balance residual bounded by combined measurement uncertainty give a calibration gate. Independent nested preparations with variance/meaningful-effect planning, randomized coded collection and technical stops are explicit. Competing identifiable models/held-out times and validated residual-inhibitor/enzyme recovery are sound; failure branches diagnose labels, washout and contamination. Main execution and ratio-estimand gaps remain.
